title: Vehicle Age Points in the Kestrel Advantage Balloon Refinance Down Payment
content:
**Risk schedule — age of the contract.** For the refinance down payment on a Kestrel Advantage Balloon Retail Installment Sale Contract, the contract carries percentage points of the balloon amount for the age of the contract, measured in whole calendar months from the contract date to the payment date:

| Whole months from contract date to payment date | Percentage points carried for age |
|---|---|
| At least 48 | 0.1 percentage points for every month beyond 22 |
| At least 36 but fewer than 48 | A flat 2.5 |
| Fewer than 36 | None |

Whole calendar months from one date to another are complete each time the later date reaches the earlier date's day of the month, so a later date that falls earlier in its month (month-end included) leaves that month incomplete.

## Hypothetical cases

| Whole months in service | Points |
|---|---|
| 35 | None |
| 36 | 2.5 |
| 47 | 2.5 |
| 48 | 0.1 times 26, that is 2.6 |
| 60 | 0.1 times 38, that is 3.8 |
